create_halpe_dataset_instance: create a HalpeDataset instance with ann_file and data_root for wholebody pose estimation
load_halpe_annotations: load Halpe dataset annotations from a COCO-style JSON file using HalpeDataset
configure_halpe_keypoints: configure HalpeDataset to use 136 keypoints covering body, foot, face, and hand regions
review_halpe_dataset_class: review the HalpeDataset class that extends BaseCocoStyleDataset for wholebody pose estimation
summarize_halpe_metainfo: summarize the HalpeDataset METAINFO configuration loaded from the halpe.py base config file
